# QuizVibe AI

> Interactive Gamified Lead Capture Minigames with AI and Voucher Rewards.

QuizVibe AI is an enterprise-grade gamification marketing platform for businesses, e-commerce stores, and social media fanpages. It enables brands to deploy interactive 5-question quizzes that engage audiences in a 30-second reflex challenge, collect verified leads (Vietnamese mobile numbers), distribute discount vouchers, and showcase top players on a live Top 10 leaderboard.

## Core Capabilities

- **AI Question Generator**: Generates 5 curated multiple-choice questions tailored to specific industries (Cosmetics, Fashion, Tech, F&B, Education, etc.) using Google Gemini with an editorial Review Gate before publication.
- **Speed Scoring Gameplay**: Tactile Duolingo-style flashcards with a synchronized 30-second timer and speed scoring bonuses (+100 to +400 points per question).
- **Lead Capture & Voucher Distribution**: Gated reward collection requiring player full name and valid 10-digit Vietnamese phone number, unlocking single-use promotional vouchers.
- **Top 10 Live Leaderboard**: Deterministic ranking based on Score DESC, Time ASC, and Submission ASC, with phone masking (0912***678) for privacy.
- **Social Sharing**: Native Facebook SDK Share Dialog with dynamic serverless Open Graph crawlers.
